_comment: WHAT THE DOG IS UP TO. Added 2026-10-18 on the household's ask: 'not just hiding in every
picture, which is funny for some pictures... have him playing on his own, if anything, or
doing something funny.' Hiding is still one of the options, and the id `hiding` is the
ORIGINAL clause, byte for byte: no `--dog-doing` flag reaches gen-scene for it, so every
picture drawn before this table existed keeps its draw digest and is reused, not redrawn.
Every other entry is something he does ON HIS OWN, away from the children: he is never
posed with them, both because that is what was asked and because his tap target is dropped
when it comes within the gutter of a child's. `do` finishes the sentence 'He is ...' and is
DESCRIBED, never named; `places` uses the closed vocabulary in scene-activities.json and
nothing means anywhere, so a mood that needs water is never drawn in a library. `seasons`
is optional and narrows a mood to part of the year (a leaf pile is autumn's).
`weight` is the seeded draw's weight when the director does not choose; the director reads
the same list. tools/scene_dog.py validates the file; `npm run verify:dog`.

moods.do: chasing his own tail in a tight, happy, dizzy circle
proudly carrying a stick far too long for him, wedged sideways across the path
flopped on his back in a pile of leaves with all four legs in the air and leaves stuck in his fur
mid-pounce at a butterfly that has landed just out of reach, ears flying
digging a hole with great seriousness, dirt flying out behind him
shaking himself dry after a swim, a spray of droplets fanning out around him
bounding through the shallows after a ball, splashing everywhere
with his whole nose buried in a snowdrift and his tail wagging in the air
sneaking off with a sandwich from an unattended plate, looking very pleased with himself
wearing a tiny party hat slipped over one ear and sniffing at a dropped piece of cake
fast asleep in a sunny patch, belly up, one ear inside out
sitting inside an open suitcase as if to say he is coming too
